hero.title: Three people. One shared standard.
hero.lede: Iridis was born from the conviction that well-written science is not a concession to popularisation: it is the standard to aspire to. We are a small team on purpose — every project goes through the same hands that scope it.

origin.label: The name
origin.intro: Latin genitive of iris: "of the iris", "of the rainbow". In scientific nomenclature, the genitive is the standard form. Three readings in a single word:

meanings.title: Iridescence
meanings.text: The hummingbird's structural colour. Not pigment: construction. Like a good text.

meanings.title: Iris
meanings.text: Precision of vision. Seeing clearly what the data says — and what it doesn't.

meanings.title: Iris, the messenger
meanings.text: The bridge between science and those who need to understand it.

team.title: Who we are
team.lede: Complementary profiles: science, writing and strategy.

members.name: Joan Martín Pérez
members.bio: Biologist and geneticist (UAB). Published researcher in nanoplastics and genotoxicology. Leads publication support and scientific content. Based in Terrassa, Spain.

members.name: Michelle Morataya-Reyes
members.bio: Biologist specialising in toxicology, genotoxicity and nanoplastics (UAB, Grupo de Mutagénesis). Leads science validation and research strategy. Based in Spain.

members.name: Laura Bilbao Broch
members.bio: MSc, Clinical Scientist in Neuropathology. Specialises in neurodegeneration, prion diseases and clinical science communication. Based in Dublin, Ireland.

items.title: You talk to the person who writes
items.text: There are no account managers between you and the text. The person who understands your project is the one who writes it.

items.title: We don't write what the data doesn't say
items.text: If the evidence doesn't support the claim, we'll tell you before a reviewer does. It's cheaper that way.

items.title: Fixed quotes, real deadlines
items.text: Scope defined per deliverable, revision rounds agreed up front, no surprises on the invoice.

items.title: English and Spanish, native to the field
items.text: We write directly in the target language. We don't translate: we write.
